versions.content: When a NodeChannel switches from state ‘NormalOperation’ to the sub state ‘AcLost’ of state ‘Offline’, the J1939 Network Management module shall notify the Basic Software Mode Manager via BswM_J1939Nm_StateChangeNotification(NM_STATE_OFFLINE).
